notes.title: Demo update - new music added!
notes.content:
Did I forget to write the news about the demo coming out? Ohh. Well...it's out! And it got another update today!

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now when writing books, one of three new tracks written for each genre of literature is played.
[*] Added close buttons for all interface screens. Except for the friends view menu - I plan to redo it completely one day.
[*] Fixed some bugs in English localization.
[/list]
[h3]What updates are in the plans:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add controller and steam deck support. Given the amount of work involved, this update will not be coming anytime soon.
[*] Change the skipping of cutscenes so that the player can't accidentally skip them.
[*] Finalize the book writing interface.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744350/Lazy_Writer_Demo/
